name: Upvimeo — Direct Uploads for Vimeo
author: upvimeo

sections.description:
Tired of the “upload_max_filesize” error, failed HTTP uploads, and wasted hosting bandwidth every time you add a big course video? Upvimeo lets you and your whole team send large videos straight from WordPress to your Vimeo account, with no server timeouts and without ever sharing your master Vimeo login.

With Upvimeo you can upload 5GB, 20GB, or even 50GB+ 4K videos directly from WordPress to Vimeo with zero server load. Every upload is unbreakable and auto-resuming, powered by Vimeo’s official TUS resumable upload protocol, so a dropped connection never ruins a two-hour upload.

Everything You Get in Upvimeo FREE

Upvimeo Free is a complete Vimeo publishing toolkit. Keep it active and you will never fight your server’s upload limits again:

  • Bypass Server Upload Limits (upload_max_filesize): Upload multi-gigabyte video files directly from the browser to Vimeo without touching your web hosting bandwidth or timing out PHP.
  • Unbreakable Resumable Uploads (TUS Protocol): If your internet connection drops mid-upload, Upvimeo automatically pauses and resumes right where it left off.
  • Gutenberg Block & Classic Editor Support: Upload and embed Vimeo videos directly inside lessons, posts, and pages without leaving WordPress.
  • Keep Clients & Authors Out of Your Vimeo Account: Let team members upload videos from WordPress into your Vimeo account without ever handing over your master Vimeo password.
  • In-Dashboard Vimeo Library & Privacy Controls: Browse your Vimeo videos, set privacy permissions (Public, Private, Unlisted, Hide from Vimeo, or specific domains), and insert responsive embeds in seconds.

Upvimeo Free also includes Vimeo folder selection, video metadata editing, a searchable in-dashboard library, and built-in connection health diagnostics. And because Sensei LMS builds its lessons in the Gutenberg editor, the Upvimeo Block works inside Sensei courses right out of the box.

Using Upvimeo Free with Tutor LMS, LearnDash & Course Builders

Running an online course site? You can start using Upvimeo Free today inside your LMS. Any LMS that lets you edit lesson content with the WordPress editor, including Tutor LMS, LearnDash, LearnPress, and Sensei LMS, can use the Upvimeo Gutenberg Block or the WP Media uploader to drop a Vimeo video straight into a lesson, page, or post. Your videos upload to Vimeo instead of your server, and your students get buffer-free, 4K-ready playback.

When you are ready to automate that workflow, with native video fields built inside the course builder itself and frontend uploads for multiple instructors, Upvimeo Pro turns your site into a hands-off, Udemy-style video marketplace (details below).

Build a Udemy-Style Marketplace with Upvimeo PRO

Upvimeo Pro adds deep, native integrations so instructors, clients, and members can upload course videos themselves, with zero server load and zero access to your Vimeo password:

  • 7 Native LMS Course Builder Integrations: Seamless backend and frontend course-builder integration for Tutor LMS, LearnDash, LearnPress, MasterStudy LMS, Academy LMS, LifterLMS, and Masteriyo.
  • Frontend Instructor Uploads: Let instructors upload massive course videos directly from the frontend LMS dashboard with zero server load, perfect for multi-instructor, Udemy-style marketplaces.
  • Form Builders & Custom Fields Support: Native Vimeo upload fields for Gravity Forms, WPForms, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) to build custom frontend video submission portals.
  • Advanced Governance & Folder Routing: Force Vimeo-only uploads, lock privacy settings, control the player and embed appearance, and route uploads into specific Vimeo folders automatically.

Test every Pro feature risk-free with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

Get Upvimeo Pro Today!

Legal Disclaimer

Upvimeo is a 3rd-party independent integration tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or maintained by Vimeo, Inc. “Vimeo” is a registered trademark of Vimeo, Inc.

External Services

This plugin relies on third-party services to function fully.

Vimeo API
This plugin connects to the Vimeo API (https://developer.vimeo.com/ and http://vimeo.com/api) to allow users to authenticate their accounts, upload videos, and fetch video metadata (such as thumbnails and titles).
* Data sent: When fetching a video, the specific Vimeo Video ID is sent to the API. During authentication and uploading, standard OAuth tokens and API keys are transmitted securely.
* Vimeo Terms of Service: https://vimeo.com/terms
* Vimeo Privacy Policy: https://vimeo.com/privacy

UpVimeo API
This plugin connects to our own API (https://upvimeo.com/wp-json/upvupdater/v1/plugins/news) to display the latest plugin news, helpful tutorials, and announcements inside your WordPress dashboard.
* Data sent: This is a standard GET request to fetch text data. No personally identifiable user data or site data is transmitted during this request.
* UpVimeo Terms & Conditions: https://upvimeo.com/terms-and-conditions/
* UpVimeo Privacy Policy: https://upvimeo.com/privacy-policy/

Source Code

In compliance with WordPress.org guidelines, this plugin uses the following third-party libraries and minified/compiled files. Unminified source code is provided as documented below.

  • SweetAlert2 (shared/js/sweetalert2.js): Used for accessible modal popups. No modifications made. Unminified source: https://github.com/sweetalert2/sweetalert2

  • tus-js-client (shared/resources/tus-js-client/tus.js, tus.min.js): Used for resumable video uploads via the TUS protocol. No modifications made. Unminified source: https://github.com/tus/tus-js-client

  • upload-modal.js (shared/js/upload-modal.js): Custom upload modal UI controller. The unminified source is located at shared/js/upload-modal.source.js within this plugin.
sections.installation:
Connecting Upvimeo to Vimeo takes about two minutes:

  1. From your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New, search for Upvimeo, then click Install Now and Activate. (Or upload the plugin ZIP under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.)
  2. Go to Upvimeo > Settings, where a short guided setup walks you through the connection.
  3. Create a free Vimeo API app, generate an Authenticated access token, and paste your Client ID, Client Secret, and Access Token into the settings. The on-screen guide links you to the exact Vimeo page and lists the scopes to tick (including upload and delete).
  4. Save. Upvimeo confirms the connection instantly, and you can start uploading to Vimeo from the Media Library, the Gutenberg Block, and the Classic Editor.

That’s it, no FTP, no server configuration, and no changes to php.ini.
sections.faq:
How do I fix the WordPress upload_max_filesize or HTTP error when uploading large videos to Vimeo?

Those errors happen because WordPress pushes the file through your server’s PHP process, which has strict size and time limits. Upvimeo skips that entirely: it streams the video from your browser straight to Vimeo using the TUS protocol, so your upload_max_filesize, post_max_size, and PHP timeout settings no longer matter. There is nothing to edit in php.ini.

Can I use Upvimeo for free with Tutor LMS, LearnDash, or LearnPress?

Yes. With the free version you can add Vimeo videos to any lesson, topic, page, or post using the Upvimeo Gutenberg Block or the WP Media uploader inside the editor. For native video fields built directly into each LMS course builder (and frontend instructor uploads), Upvimeo Pro adds dedicated integrations for Tutor LMS, LearnDash, LearnPress, MasterStudy LMS, Academy LMS, LifterLMS, and Masteriyo.

Does uploading a 10GB or 50GB video slow down my WordPress hosting server?

No. The video never passes through your web host. Upvimeo uploads directly from the browser to Vimeo’s servers, so your hosting bandwidth, disk space, and CPU stay untouched, no matter how large the file is.

What happens if my internet disconnects during a large video upload?

Nothing is lost. The TUS resumable protocol remembers exactly how much has uploaded, so when the connection returns Upvimeo picks up right where it left off instead of starting over.

Can instructors or editors upload videos to Vimeo without having my Vimeo login credentials?

Yes, and it is one of the most popular reasons teams use Upvimeo. Team members upload from inside WordPress into your connected Vimeo account without ever seeing your Vimeo email or password. Upvimeo Pro extends this to frontend LMS dashboards so instructors can upload course videos themselves.

Which LMS and form plugins are natively supported in Upvimeo Pro?

Upvimeo Pro includes native course-builder integrations for Tutor LMS, LearnDash, LearnPress, MasterStudy LMS, Academy LMS, LifterLMS, and Masteriyo, plus native Vimeo upload fields for Gravity Forms, WPForms, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF).

Do I need a paid Vimeo account to use Upvimeo?

You need a Vimeo account with API access and an access token that includes upload permission. A free Vimeo account can connect, but Vimeo enforces its own weekly upload quota and reserves some options (such as certain privacy settings) for paid tiers. For heavy or 4K libraries we recommend a paid Vimeo plan, which Upvimeo fully supports.

Is Upvimeo affiliated with Vimeo?

No. Upvimeo is an independent, third-party integration tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or maintained by Vimeo, Inc. “Vimeo” is a registered trademark of Vimeo, Inc.

short_description: Video upload, library & embed block for Vimeo — upload large videos to Vimeo from WordPress without server limits, then manage and embed them.
description:
Tired of the “upload_max_filesize” error, failed HTTP uploads, and wasted hosting bandwidth every time you add a big course video? Upvimeo lets you and your whole team send large videos straight from WordPress to your Vimeo account, with no server timeouts and without ever sharing your master Vimeo login.

With Upvimeo you can upload 5GB, 20GB, or even 50GB+ 4K videos directly from WordPress to Vimeo with zero server load. Every upload is unbreakable and auto-resuming, powered by Vimeo’s official TUS resumable upload protocol, so a dropped connection never ruins a two-hour upload.

Everything You Get in Upvimeo FREE

Upvimeo Free is a complete Vimeo publishing toolkit. Keep it active and you will never fight your server’s upload limits again:

  • Bypass Server Upload Limits (upload_max_filesize): Upload multi-gigabyte video files directly from the browser to Vimeo without touching your web hosting bandwidth or timing out PHP.
  • Unbreakable Resumable Uploads (TUS Protocol): If your internet connection drops mid-upload, Upvimeo automatically pauses and resumes right where it left off.
  • Gutenberg Block & Classic Editor Support: Upload and embed Vimeo videos directly inside lessons, posts, and pages without leaving WordPress.
  • Keep Clients & Authors Out of Your Vimeo Account: Let team members upload videos from WordPress into your Vimeo account without ever handing over your master Vimeo password.
  • In-Dashboard Vimeo Library & Privacy Controls: Browse your Vimeo videos, set privacy permissions (Public, Private, Unlisted, Hide from Vimeo, or specific domains), and insert responsive embeds in seconds.

Upvimeo Free also includes Vimeo folder selection, video metadata editing, a searchable in-dashboard library, and built-in connection health diagnostics. And because Sensei LMS builds its lessons in the Gutenberg editor, the Upvimeo Block works inside Sensei courses right out of the box.

Using Upvimeo Free with Tutor LMS, LearnDash & Course Builders

Running an online course site? You can start using Upvimeo Free today inside your LMS. Any LMS that lets you edit lesson content with the WordPress editor, including Tutor LMS, LearnDash, LearnPress, and Sensei LMS, can use the Upvimeo Gutenberg Block or the WP Media uploader to drop a Vimeo video straight into a lesson, page, or post. Your videos upload to Vimeo instead of your server, and your students get buffer-free, 4K-ready playback.

When you are ready to automate that workflow, with native video fields built inside the course builder itself and frontend uploads for multiple instructors, Upvimeo Pro turns your site into a hands-off, Udemy-style video marketplace (details below).

Build a Udemy-Style Marketplace with Upvimeo PRO

Upvimeo Pro adds deep, native integrations so instructors, clients, and members can upload course videos themselves, with zero server load and zero access to your Vimeo password:

  • 7 Native LMS Course Builder Integrations: Seamless backend and frontend course-builder integration for Tutor LMS, LearnDash, LearnPress, MasterStudy LMS, Academy LMS, LifterLMS, and Masteriyo.
  • Frontend Instructor Uploads: Let instructors upload massive course videos directly from the frontend LMS dashboard with zero server load, perfect for multi-instructor, Udemy-style marketplaces.
  • Form Builders & Custom Fields Support: Native Vimeo upload fields for Gravity Forms, WPForms, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) to build custom frontend video submission portals.
  • Advanced Governance & Folder Routing: Force Vimeo-only uploads, lock privacy settings, control the player and embed appearance, and route uploads into specific Vimeo folders automatically.

Test every Pro feature risk-free with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

Get Upvimeo Pro Today!

Legal Disclaimer

Upvimeo is a 3rd-party independent integration tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or maintained by Vimeo, Inc. “Vimeo” is a registered trademark of Vimeo, Inc.

External Services

This plugin relies on third-party services to function fully.

Vimeo API
This plugin connects to the Vimeo API (https://developer.vimeo.com/ and http://vimeo.com/api) to allow users to authenticate their accounts, upload videos, and fetch video metadata (such as thumbnails and titles).
* Data sent: When fetching a video, the specific Vimeo Video ID is sent to the API. During authentication and uploading, standard OAuth tokens and API keys are transmitted securely.
* Vimeo Terms of Service: https://vimeo.com/terms
* Vimeo Privacy Policy: https://vimeo.com/privacy

UpVimeo API
This plugin connects to our own API (https://upvimeo.com/wp-json/upvupdater/v1/plugins/news) to display the latest plugin news, helpful tutorials, and announcements inside your WordPress dashboard.
* Data sent: This is a standard GET request to fetch text data. No personally identifiable user data or site data is transmitted during this request.
* UpVimeo Terms & Conditions: https://upvimeo.com/terms-and-conditions/
* UpVimeo Privacy Policy: https://upvimeo.com/privacy-policy/

Source Code

In compliance with WordPress.org guidelines, this plugin uses the following third-party libraries and minified/compiled files. Unminified source code is provided as documented below.

  • SweetAlert2 (shared/js/sweetalert2.js): Used for accessible modal popups. No modifications made. Unminified source: https://github.com/sweetalert2/sweetalert2

  • tus-js-client (shared/resources/tus-js-client/tus.js, tus.min.js): Used for resumable video uploads via the TUS protocol. No modifications made. Unminified source: https://github.com/tus/tus-js-client

  • upload-modal.js (shared/js/upload-modal.js): Custom upload modal UI controller. The unminified source is located at shared/js/upload-modal.source.js within this plugin.
